item.title: Soma 1.0 (571)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (571)

  • Backups now appear in the Log (made, failed, and old ones removed), and Cortex can answer questions about them. Bullets no longer jump a space when you start typing. Shift-Up and Shift-Down now show the selection in notes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
